purpose: Where each kind of data comes from, and which symbols the free Financial Modeling Prep key serves. Measured on 18 November 2026 with scripts/analysis/probe_fmp.py and probe_fmp_coverage.py. Decision record: docs/decisions/2026-11-18-data-sources.md.

price_history.provider: Yahoo chart endpoint, cached in label_out/prices

filings.note: SEC_USER_AGENT is in .env, set by the operator. Read by section, never whole: tradecraft/data/edgar.py

macro_and_fed_calendar.provider: FRED release calendar and the Federal Reserve's FOMC schedule
macro_and_fed_calendar.key: FRED_API_KEY in .env, added by the operator
macro_and_fed_calendar.note: The four releases were chosen by the operator on 18 November 2026. FRED lists scheduled dates only a few weeks ahead; beyond the last listed date a release is not yet scheduled, which is not the same as no release.

earnings_dates.gap: No time of day. Treat the report day as inside any window that contains it.

past_earnings.note: Actual against estimated, back many years

dividends.note: date is the ex-dividend date. A future ex-date appears only once declared; before that, estimate from frequency and say it is an estimate.

analyst_estimates.gap: Current consensus only. No revision history: build it by saving the consensus each day.

company_news.status: adopted for the demo, premium plan (18 November 2026)
company_news.note: Untrusted text: wrapped and labelled as data. Refused on the free plan.

sector_context.provider: FMP profile sector, mapped to a SPDR sector fund; prices from the Yahoo chart endpoint
sector_context.status: adopted for the demo (operator decision, 18 November 2026)
sector_context.note: Sector names are FMP's. A sector not listed here gives 'not available'.

market_regime.status: adopted for the demo (operator decision, 18 November 2026)
market_regime.note: Index-level VIX only. The underlying's own implied volatility is never used in stage 2.

fmp_free_plan.note: SPY is covered but has no earnings and no analyst estimates, as expected for a fund.

fmp_plan.note: Upgraded from the free plan after the measurements in fmp_free_plan were taken. Operator decision, 18 November 2026 (evening): the demo uses company news and the wider symbol coverage; quarterly estimates and the limit parameter are not adopted. See docs/decisions/2026-11-18-data-sources.md.

measured_2026_11_18.how: scripts/analysis/probe_fmp.py and probe_fmp_coverage.py (outputs test_out/fmp_probe_20261118_184622.json, test_out/fmp_coverage_20261118_184800.json), then a re-check with httpx
measured_2026_11_18.earnings_coverage: 105 of 106 universe symbols; BRK.B refused (402, special symbol)
measured_2026_11_18.company_news: served (/stable/news/stock, 20 rows for NVDA and for QQQ)
measured_2026_11_18.earnings_time_of_day: still not available: neither /stable/earnings nor /stable/earnings-calendar has a before-open or after-close field
measured_2026_11_18.transport_note: The stdlib urllib client in the probe scripts had large responses cut off (IncompleteRead) on 55 symbols; the same requests through httpx all completed. Application code uses httpx with retries.
